summaries.main.py: Bot entry point (SLASH COMMANDS ONLY). Registers slash commands via @bot.tree.command in setup_commands(), syncs via bot.tree.sync() in on_ready(). No text/prefix commands. No business logic.
summaries.config.py: Environment configuration. Loads DISCORD_TOKEN, DB credentials, PORT, PROJECT_ID, GUILD_ID from .env file.
summaries.commands/start.py: /start slash command handler. Registers Discord user in database via interaction.user.
summaries.commands/help.py: /help slash command handler. Displays list of available slash commands.
summaries.commands/ask.py: /ask <query> slash command handler. Routes free-text query through process_user_input() in ai_logic.py.
summaries.commands/status.py: /status slash command handler. Shows bot status, guild count, and latency via interaction.client.
summaries.services/ai_logic.py: The /ask brain. process_user_input(text) detects intent from free-text query, calls APIs, returns responses. PRIMARY file to modify for bot behavior.
summaries.services/api_client.py: External API client. All HTTP requests go here. Functions: fetch_json, safe_get, fetch_page, get_crypto_price, get_weather, get_news.
summaries.services/web_scraper.py: CDP web scraper using chrome-devtools-mcp. Supports config-driven extraction, custom scraper classes, pagination, auth, JS extraction, and scraper registry for LLM extensibility.
summaries.services/mock_data.py: Fallback mock responses when API is unavailable or intent is unclear.
summaries.models/user.py: User model with database CRUD operations. Supports Discord user auto-creation.
summaries.core/database.py: PostgreSQL connection manager. Provides get_db() for raw connections and get_db_cursor() context manager with auto commit/rollback.
summaries.utils/logger.py: Simple logging configuration with console handler.
summaries.requirements.txt: Python dependencies: discord.py, requests, python-dotenv, psycopg2-binary.
summaries..env.example: Environment variable template. Copy to .env and fill in values.

main.py.purpose: Bot entry point - slash command registration and startup

commands/ask.py.purpose: /ask slash command - process free-text AI queries

services/web_scraper.py.purpose: CDP web scraper service for dynamic website extraction
